title: How We Built a $40bn Fintech w/ Guillaume Pousaz (Checkout.com) Ophelia Brown (Blossom Capital).
description:
Seedery is the UK's largest student startup event connecting over 2,500+ students, founders and investors across 2 action-packed days. Don't miss Seedery 2022 and apply today on www.seedery.io 

🚀 Guillaume moved to California to pursue his love of surfing, and landed in Silicon Valley. He then rode the fintech gold rush to a multi-billion-dollar fortune. Checkout.com is now one of the largest fintechs globally with 19 offices spanning from SF to HK and a team of 1,500+ people.

⚡️Ophelia founded Blossom Capital with a goal of bringing a highly differentiated approach to early stage venture capital. Blossom’s mission is to supercharge the most visionary founders in Europe, enabling them to build companies which compete on a global scale.
fulltitle: How We Built a $40bn Fintech w/ Guillaume Pousaz (Checkout.com) Ophelia Brown (Blossom Capital).
